title: How to Do the Electric Slide | Sexy Dance Moves

observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

extraction.teacher_style: Two instructors break down the Electric Slide step-by-step with clear counting and verbal guidance. They demonstrate the routine together from the front and add variations for added flair.

lesson_structure.note: Instructors introduce themselves and the dance
Step-by-step breakdown of the basic electric slide
Demonstrating the full basic routine facing forward and changing walls
Repeating the routine with added spice and stylistic variations

Showing the progression from basic to advanced variations

This dance repeats over and over again.
